sloka: यदि मत्सन्निधौ सीता धर्षिता स्यात्त्वया बलात् ।भ्रातरं तु खरं पश्येस्तदा मत्सायकैर्हतः ।। ६.१०५.१८ ।।
transliteration: yadi matsannidhau sītā dharṣitā syāttvayā balāt ।bhrātaraṁ tu kharaṁ paśyestadā matsāyakairhataḥ ।। 6.105.18 ।।

translations.english: "If Sita had been seen by me forcibly taken by you in my presence, then you would have been killed by my arrows and seen your brother Khara."
